name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R3 hard Existence(holding_box) is redundant. The task already requires the agent to be holding the box at the exit (Response(at_exit, holding_box)) and to pick it up immediately after any fall (ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)). Therefore Existence(holding_box) adds no new requirement and violates compactness. Remove the Existence(holding_box) clause.

texts: Reach the exit at some point
When the agent is at the exit, it must be holding the box
Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the very next step
